description: Returns one company's current snapshot: price with its market session (open or closed, last close, next open; `listedOn` for a recent listing), performance, 52-week range, trend, fundamentals from the company's SEC XBRL filings, balance sheet (cash, debt as the filed balance sheet presents it — each line, with the page on sec.gov —, the notes, loans and share offerings filed since that balance sheet, operating cash flow, runway, share count and dilution), risk (beta against the sector with its r², historical volatility and its one-year rank), FINRA short interest (latest settlement, short float on a float counted from SEC filings, one year of history), FINRA short volume, and the company's SEC profile with the description from its latest annual report. Every figure carries the date it holds for. Use it when the user asks about one company's price, market cap, valuation, fundamentals or risk. A company not listed yet that has filed a public prospectus (pre-IPO, e.g. 'anthropic') returns what the prospectus and the funds file instead: no price, the last round per common share, the implied value on both share counts, the rounds, capital, financials, its unaudited quarters (with an estimate of the next quarter from figures the prospectus states, said to be one), what it has committed to spend with each supplier and what that weighs for the tracked ones, the non-voting holdings of Amazon and Google rebuilt from the prospectus, its price/sales at the last round's price and the round prices over 52 weeks, its customers by revenue tier, revenue by model, cloud marketplace share, credit facility, note purchase facilities and share purchase commitments, voting structure and what it signed and granted since its last statements, fund marks, and its profile (SEC identity, incorporation and website from the prospectus, its own description).

symbol.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. NVDA, AMD, ASML, 'nvidia', 'taiwan semiconductor'. Case-insensitive.
